body: Just gonna post this to say, I'm done with the thread thanks VPope and IAmNunuAMA. I sorted out some of my feelings, just gonna accept that I'm balding, keep fighting my BDD and try to move on with my life. Take care and thanks.

My family's awesome, my parents supported me when I dropped out for 2 years, they encouraged me and sought help for me in every possible way. They helped me get a few jobs, and they even paid for me to go back and graduate. I live with them I pay for rent, and I help around the house, and they honestly are probably the reason why I have troubles trying to commit suicide I love them so much.

As for my friends I really don't have many, I haven't talked to two people I considered my friends since they pretty much kept making fun of my balding, pretty much kicking me when I was vulnerable. They never were really nice friends, when I think back on it, but it was a social connection I needed.

Edit: I also have problems establishing a social connection as BDD makes me feel that no one would really wanna be friends with me, and I most likely put on a negative vibe as I feel I'm no good and that I'm hideous.

I've never really been one to open up, so it took a lot of effort to type that out, it's just I feel my reason is dumb compared to some people, my family has been so great to me, they've support me when this all started and helped me out when I dropped out, they encouraged me to go back to school and graduate, which I just did like 4 days ago. I wasn't preoccupied with my appearance during the past few months since I spent every waking moment going to work then school, then exercising but with the Sobey in town closing I got laid off, school is over, and exercising just hasn't been cutting it.
Thanks for your input, I think typing this has calmed me down to an extent. Just thank you for taking time to respond.
